results.answer: The PBX service shows as up. Since this affects everyone, try these steps from our VoIP runbook first (especially step 4 for desk phones):

This sounds like a one-way audio issue over VPN. Based on our runbook, here are the steps to try, in order of likelihood to help you fastest (the top one is the most common fix): 1. Disconnect the VPN, restart the softphone, then reconnect the VPN and test again. One-way audio over VPN is usually a NAT issue and this often clears it. 2. Make sure your headset/microphone is plugged in and selected as the audio input device in the softphone settings. 3. Try an internal call to another extension. If internal calls work but external ones don’t, the problem may be with the outside line rather than your setup. 4. If you also have a desk phone, unplug its network cable for 10 seconds so it re-registers with the PBX. I checked the PBX service and it’s currently healthy. If none of the steps above restore two-way audio, please let me know and I’ll open a VOIP ticket for you.

Here are the standard steps for a slow laptop. Try them in order and let me know if it’s still slow after you finish — then we can open a ticket if needed.1. **Restart the laptop** (a full restart, not just sleep/hibernate). Many slow laptops haven’t been restarted in weeks.   2. Open **Task Manager** (Ctrl+Shift+Esc), sort by **Memory**, and close browser tabs or apps you’re not using.   3. Check **free disk space** — if it’s under 10 % free, that will make everything sluggish. Free up space if needed.   4. Install any **pending Windows/app updates**, then restart again.   If the laptop is still slow after these steps, we’ll open a ticket (category **hardware**, priority **low**) — it may need more memory or a new disk. Let me know how it goes.

The intranet service is currently **up** (HTTP 200, 21.7 ms latency). Since it’s responding but feels slow, try these steps on your end first: 1) Clear your browser cache/cookies or try a different browser. 2) Restart your computer (a full restart, not sleep). 3) Check if other internal sites load slowly too—if only the intranet is slow, it may be a content‑specific issue. 4) Run a quick speed test (e.g., speedtest.net) and compare with a colleague nearby. If the problem persists after these steps, let me know and I can open a ticket for further investigation.

The mail service is confirmed down. I've opened ticket #1 (high priority, email category) and queued a restart request for human approval. A technician will investigate and approve the restart. You'll be updated via the ticket.

The intranet service is currently up and responding normally (HTTP 200, 21 ms latency). I cannot queue a restart request for a service that is healthy — the restart tool is only used when check_service shows the service is down. If you’re seeing a specific problem (slow pages, errors, certain pages not loading), please tell me the symptoms and I’ll follow the appropriate runbook or open a ticket for the infrastructure team.

results.answer: The PBX service is currently **up** (port open, 1.2 ms latency), so a restart isn’t warranted.   Try these steps first (from the VoIP runbook): 1. Check your headset/headphones are fully plugged in and selected as the audio device in your softphone. 2. Make a test call to an internal extension. If internal calls sound fine, the issue is likely the external trunk. 3. If you’re on VPN, disconnect it, restart the softphone, and test again—one‑way audio over VPN is often a NAT problem. 4. If **nobody** can make any calls (all internal and external calls fail), let me know and I’ll open a critical VoIP ticket. Otherwise, try the steps above and report back.

Please do not share your password in chat — the helpdesk never asks for it. Your account may be locked after too many failed attempts; it unlocks automatically after 15 minutes if you stop trying. To reset your password, use the “Forgot password” link on the login screen — it sends a code to your registered phone. New passwords must be at least 12 characters and cannot repeat your last 5 passwords. After resetting, update the password in your phone’s mail app as well, or the account may lock again. If you no longer have access to that phone, please let me know and I’ll open a ticket for you (category: access, priority: medium).

جرب الخطوات دي بالترتيب، وغالباً هاتحل المشكلة لو التلفون لوحده معطل والزملاء شغالين: 1. تأكد إن السماعة/السماعة السلكية (handset) متصلة كويس في مدخلها على التلفون. 2. افصل كابل الشبكة (الإنترنت) من خلف التلفون لـ 10 ثواني، ثم ركبوا تاني – ده بيخلي التلفون يسجل من جديد على السنترال (PBX). 3. جرب تعمل مكالمة داخلية لزميل تاني – لو المكالمة الداخلية شغالة، يبقى الخط الخارجي مش هو المشكلة. لو بعد الخطوات دي الصوت مش راجع، افتح تذكرة وأحولك للفريق الفني.
